description: US Stanford attribute-only feed (csv, semicolon-delimited, LF, 4 columns): part number, short description, manufacturer and product name without tag symbols plus volume. No prices.

columns.expression: lookup(row['sku'], 'cst_product_name_with_volume.csv', 'product_name_no_tag_symbols_with_volume', clean_ariba_text(row['long_description'], True, False) + ' ' + row['size'] + ' ' + row['size_unit'].replace(chr(181), 'u'))
